## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text is [淨源](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B7%A8%E6%BA%90) Jìngyuán's compact version of [宗密](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%97%E5%AF%86) Zōngmì's *[Yuánjué jīng dàochǎng xiūzhèng yí](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0155)* (X1475, 18 fasc.). The drastic reduction — from 18 fascicles to 1 — provides a portable practitioner's edition suitable for everyday monastic use, distinct from the elaborate full-length ritual.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (1067 – 1088) reflects [淨源](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B7%A8%E6%BA%90) Jìngyuán's mature editorial activity. The work is part of his comprehensive Northern-Sòng project of consolidating and abbreviating the Tang Buddhist liturgical heritage for Sòng monastic use.

The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X1476) collection.
